title: Hospital Registration Success
description: Verify hospital user can successfully register with valid data and receive a JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to hospital registration page
Input valid hospital registration details (name, email, password, address)
Submit registration form
Check that registration is successful and JWT token is issued

title: Ambulance Registration Success
description: Verify ambulance user can successfully register with valid details and receive a JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to ambulance registration page
Input valid ambulance registration details (vehicle id, email, password, driver details)
Submit registration form
Check that ambulance registration is successful and JWT token is issued

title: Hospital Login with Correct Credentials
description: Verify hospital user can login successfully with correct email and password and receive valid JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to hospital login page
Enter valid email and password for a registered hospital
Click login
Verify login success and JWT token returned

title: Ambulance Login with Correct Credentials
description: Verify ambulance user can login successfully with correct credentials and receive valid JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to ambulance login page
Enter valid ambulance email and password
Click login
Verify login success and JWT token returned

title: Login Failure with Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify login fails with incorrect email or password and appropriate error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to login page (hospital or ambulance)
Enter invalid email or wrong password
Try to login
Verify login failure and error message is displayed

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Verify hospital users cannot access ambulance-only pages and vice versa; unauthorized access is blocked.

steps.description: Login as hospital user
Attempt to navigate to ambulance dashboard URL
Verify access is denied or redirected
Login as ambulance user
Attempt to navigate to hospital dashboard URL
Verify access is denied or redirected

title: Hospital Doctor Management CRUD Operations
description: Verify hospital staff can add, edit, delete, and toggle availability of doctors successfully.

steps.description: Login as hospital user
Navigate to doctor management page
Add a new doctor with valid details
Check new doctor is listed with correct details
Edit the added doctor's qualification and specialization
Verify updated doctor details are saved and displayed
Toggle doctor's availability status
Verify availability change is reflected in doctor list and real-time updated to ambulances
Delete the doctor
Verify the doctor is removed from the list

title: Ambulance Hospital Search by Location and Filters
description: Verify ambulance users can search nearby hospitals using map location, distance filter, and specialization filters with correct results.

steps.description: Login as ambulance user
Navigate to hospital search page
Allow location access and verify map centers on ambulance location
Apply distance and specialization filters
Verify hospitals displayed on map and list meet search criteria and show real-time availability

title: Emergency Request Creation and Notification Flow
description: Verify that ambulance can create an emergency request, hospital receives real-time notification, and hospital can accept or update status with updates broadcast back.

steps.description: Login as ambulance
Create an emergency request selecting a hospital from search
Verify emergency request successfully created and ambulance sees request status
Login as hospital user on another device or session
Verify hospital receives real-time notification of new emergency request
Hospital accepts emergency and updates status
Verify ambulance receives real-time status update
Ambulance updates emergency lifecycle statuses (en route, arrived, completed)
Verify hospital dashboard updates in real-time accordingly

title: Real-time Doctor Availability Updates
description: Verify toggling doctor availability by hospital user updates ambulance search results and all relevant users in real-time.

steps.description: Login as hospital and navigate to doctor management
Toggle availability status of a doctor
Verify ambulance users searching hospitals see immediate updated availability

title: Ambulance Location Tracking Accuracy
description: Verify ambulance location uses browser geolocation to update position accurately on server and map reflects current location with real-time updates.

steps.description: Login as ambulance
Allow browser location access
Verify ambulance location is sent to server and updated on dashboard map
Simulate location change (move ambulance)
Verify updated location broadcasts and map marker position changes in real-time

title: Profile Management for Hospital and Ambulance
description: Verify users can view and edit their profile information correctly, and changes persist after saving.

steps.description: Login as hospital user
Navigate to hospital profile page
Edit profile fields and save changes
Verify updated profile info is persisted and displayed correctly
Repeat above steps for ambulance user

title: Protected Route Access Control
description: Verify unauthenticated users cannot access protected routes, and users with invalid/expired tokens are redirected to login.

steps.description: Attempt to access hospital or ambulance dashboard URL without logging in
Verify redirect to login page
Login and get valid JWT token
Manually expire or invalidate token
Attempt to navigate protected routes
Verify user is logged out and redirected to login

title: System-Wide Statistics Display and Accuracy
description: Verify hospital and ambulance dashboards show accurate statistics including counts of hospitals, doctors, available doctors, and emergency request statuses.

steps.description: Login as hospital user
Verify statistics panel displays correct data matching the backend counts
Login as ambulance user
Verify ambulance dashboard statistics reflect accurate live data

title: UI Responsiveness across Devices
description: Verify the UI components, including dashboards, forms, and maps, are responsive and accessible on different screen sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile).

steps.description: Open application on desktop screen
Verify UI elements render correctly without overlap or cutoff, and animations/glassmorphism appear correctly
Resize viewport to tablet size and reload
Verify UI adjusts layout appropriately with accessible navigation
Resize viewport to mobile size and reload
Verify mobile friendly navigation, readable text, and usable interactive elements

title: Real-Time Socket.io Communication Stability
description: Verify real-time notifications, status updates, and emergency communications are delivered reliably over Socket.io connections without data loss on stable and unstable network conditions.

steps.description: Establish two sessions: ambulance and hospital users
Trigger emergency requests and status updates between ambulance and hospital
Verify real-time data is received instantly on opposite side
Simulate brief network interruptions and reconnections
Verify messages delivered after reconnection without duplication or loss

title: Error Handling for Invalid Emergency Request Data
description: Verify that emergency request creation validates input data and shows appropriate error messages for invalid or missing required fields.

steps.description: Login as ambulance
Attempt to create emergency request with missing hospital selection or incomplete patient details
Verify creation is blocked and descriptive validation error messages are displayed

title: Logout and Token Invalidation
description: Verify that logout properly clears user session and invalidates token to prevent further access to protected endpoints without login.

steps.description: Login as hospital or ambulance user
Click logout button
Verify user redirected to login page and token is removed from client storage
Attempt to access protected API endpoints with previous token
Verify access is denied with authentication error

title: Hospital Emergency Request Handling Deadlines and Edge Cases
description: Verify handling of emergency requests when no doctors are available or hospital is at capacity; system should notify ambulance accordingly.

steps.description: Set hospital doctor availability to zero
Ambulance creates emergency request to that hospital
Verify hospital dashboard shows pending request but no available doctors, and ambulance receives notification about lack of capacity

title: Map Interaction and Hospital Selection on Ambulance Dashboard
description: Verify ambulance user can interact with Leaflet map, select hospitals, and hospital selection reflects in emergency creation form.

steps.description: Login as ambulance user
Navigate to hospital search map
Click on hospital markers on the map
Verify selected hospital details populate emergency creation form fields
